Transport Documents

Sertifikat Sanitasi

An official statement confirming that animal or animal-based products meet the required sanitary standards for international movement as per importing country regulations.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Sertifikat Sanitasi?

In this glossary, Sertifikat Sanitasi refers to: An official statement confirming that animal or animal-based products meet the required sanitary standards for international movement as per importing country regulations.

How is Sertifikat Sanitasi used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Setiap pengiriman produk susu ke Uni Eropa memerlukan Sertifikat Sanitasi."

Why does Sertifikat Sanitasi matter in logistics?

Sertifikat Sanitasi matters because it supports clear communication in Transport Documents contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Sertifikat Sanitasi?

Sertifikat Sanitasi is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does Sertifikat Sanitasi belong to?

In this glossary, Sertifikat Sanitasi is grouped under Transport Documents. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

An official statement confirming that animal or animal-based products meet the required sanitary standards for international movement as per importing country regulations.

Operational example

A sanitary certificate is required for each consignment of dairy products exported to the European Union.

Localized term

Sertifikat Sanitasi

Localized example
